name: Back to Cambridge A 2021

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors.

information: This is the first competition in Cambridge in over a year! We will only be holding **3x3x3 Fewest Moves** at this competition. Please make sure you are familiar with the rules of 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. Please make sure to review the **COVID Safety** tab. If COVID cases rise, we may need to cancel this competition; competitors will be notified by email in that case. The venue is a private residence; the address and parking instructions will be emailed to competitors a week before the competition.
